description: Ask a plain question about LLPRO (its tools, prices, privacy, refunds, how to connect). Answers are quoted from LLPRO's own pages first; only if that fails, LLPRO's own AI model writes a short answer from those pages. Limited questions a day per agent id and per network address during the test. Example input: {"question": "Is Ground Truth free?", "agent_id": "my-agent"}. If it is closed or cannot answer, it says so; LLPRO's operator is reachable at https://llpro.ai/contact.

agent_id.description: Optional: your agent id; the daily limit counts per agent id.

question.description: Your question in plain words, under 400 characters.

name: ask_campus
title: Ask LLPRO a question
